1	// Parse backticks
2	
3	import type StateInline from './state_inline.ts'
4	
5	export default function backtick (state: StateInline, silent: boolean): boolean {
6	  let pos = state.pos
7	  const ch = state.src.charCodeAt(pos)
8	
9	  if (ch !== 0x60/* ` */) { return false }
10	
11	  const start = pos
12	  pos++
13	  const max = state.posMax
14	
15	  // scan marker length
16	  while (pos < max && state.src.charCodeAt(pos) === 0x60/* ` */) { pos++ }
17	
18	  const marker = state.src.slice(start, pos)
19	  const openerLength = marker.length
20	
21	  if (state.backticksScanned && (state.backticks[openerLength] || 0) <= start) {
22	    if (!silent) state.pending += marker
23	    state.pos += openerLength
24	    return true
25	  }
26	
27	  let matchEnd = pos
28	  let matchStart
29	
30	  // Nothing found in the cache, scan until the end of the line (or until marker is found)
31	  while ((matchStart = state.src.indexOf('`', matchEnd)) !== -1) {
32	    matchEnd = matchStart + 1
33	
34	    // scan marker length
35	    while (matchEnd < max && state.src.charCodeAt(matchEnd) === 0x60/* ` */) { matchEnd++ }
36	
37	    const closerLength = matchEnd - matchStart
38	
39	    if (closerLength === openerLength) {
40	      // Found matching closer length.
41	      if (!silent) {
42	        const token = state.push('code_inline', 'code', 0)
43	        token.markup = marker
44	        token.content = state.src.slice(pos, matchStart)
45	          .replace(/\n/g, ' ')
46	          .replace(/^ (.+) $/, '$1')
47	      }
48	      state.pos = matchEnd
49	      return true
50	    }
51	
52	    // Some different length found, put it in cache as upper limit of where closer can be found
53	    state.backticks[closerLength] = matchStart
54	  }
55	
56	  // Scanned through the end, didn't find anything
57	  state.backticksScanned = true
58	
59	  if (!silent) state.pending += marker
60	  state.pos += openerLength
61	  return true
62	}

1	// Process [link](<to> "stuff")
2	
3	import { normalizeReference, isSpace } from '../common/utils.ts'
4	import type StateInline from './state_inline.ts'
5	
6	export default function link (state: StateInline, silent: boolean): boolean {
7	  let code, label, res, ref
8	  let href = ''
9	  let title = ''
10	  let start = state.pos
11	  let parseReference = true
12	
13	  if (state.src.charCodeAt(state.pos) !== 0x5B/* [ */) { return false }
14	
15	  const oldPos = state.pos
16	  const max = state.posMax
17	  const labelStart = state.pos + 1
18	  const labelEnd = state.md.helpers.parseLinkLabel(state, state.pos, true)
19	
20	  // parser failed to find ']', so it's not a valid link
21	  if (labelEnd < 0) { return false }
22	
23	  let pos = labelEnd + 1
24	  if (pos < max && state.src.charCodeAt(pos) === 0x28/* ( */) {
25	    //
26	    // Inline link
27	    //
28	
29	    // might have found a valid shortcut link, disable reference parsing
30	    parseReference = false
31	
32	    // [link](  <href>  "title"  )
33	    //        ^^ skipping these spaces
34	    pos++
35	    for (; pos < max; pos++) {
36	      code = state.src.charCodeAt(pos)
37	      if (!isSpace(code) && code !== 0x0A) { break }
38	    }
39	    if (pos >= max) { return false }
40	
41	    // [link](  <href>  "title"  )
42	    //          ^^^^^^ parsing link destination
43	    start = pos
44	    res = state.md.helpers.parseLinkDestination(state.src, pos, state.posMax)
45	    if (res.ok) {
46	      href = state.md.normalizeLink(res.str)
47	      if (state.md.validateLink(href)) {
48	        pos = res.pos
49	      } else {
50	        href = ''
51	      }
52	
53	      // [link](  <href>  "title"  )
54	      //                ^^ skipping these spaces
55	      start = pos
56	      for (; pos < max; pos++) {
57	        code = state.src.charCodeAt(pos)
58	        if (!isSpace(code) && code !== 0x0A) { break }
59	      }
60	
61	      // [link](  <href>  "title"  )
62	      //                  ^^^^^^^ parsing link title
63	      res = state.md.helpers.parseLinkTitle(state.src, pos, state.posMax)
64	      if (pos < max && start !== pos && res.ok) {
65	        title = res.str
66	        pos = res.pos
67	
68	        // [link](  <href>  "title"  )
69	        //                         ^^ skipping these spaces
70	        for (; pos < max; pos++) {
71	          code = state.src.charCodeAt(pos)
72	          if (!isSpace(code) && code !== 0x0A) { break }
73	        }
74	      }
75	    }
76	
77	    if (pos >= max || state.src.charCodeAt(pos) !== 0x29/* ) */) {
78	      // parsing a valid shortcut link failed, fallback to reference
79	      parseReference = true
80	    }
81	    pos++
82	  }
83	
84	  if (parseReference) {
85	    //
86	    // Link reference
87	    //
88	    if (typeof state.env.references === 'undefined') { return false }
89	
90	    if (pos < max && state.src.charCodeAt(pos) === 0x5B/* [ */) {
91	      start = pos + 1
92	      pos = state.md.helpers.parseLinkLabel(state, pos)
93	      if (pos >= 0) {
94	        label = state.src.slice(start, pos++)
95	      } else {
96	        pos = labelEnd + 1
97	      }
98	    } else {
99	      pos = labelEnd + 1
100	    }
101	
102	    // covers label === '' and label === undefined
103	    // (collapsed reference link and shortcut reference link respectively)
104	    if (!label) { label = state.src.slice(labelStart, labelEnd) }
105	
106	    label = normalizeReference(label)
107	    ref = state.env.references[label]
108	    if (!ref) {
109	      state.pos = oldPos
110	      return false
111	    }
112	    href = ref.href
113	    title = ref.title
114	  }
115	
116	  //
117	  // We found the end of the link, and know for a fact it's a valid link;
118	  // so all that's left to do is to call tokenizer.
119	  //
120	  if (!silent) {
121	    state.pos = labelStart
122	    state.posMax = labelEnd
123	
124	    const token_o = state.push('link_open', 'a', 1)
125	    const attrs: Array<[string, string]> = [['href', href]]
126	    token_o.attrs = attrs
127	    if (title) {
128	      attrs.push(['title', title])
129	    }
130	    if (label) {
131	      const meta: Record<string, unknown> = Object.create(null)
132	      meta.label = label
133	      token_o.meta = meta
134	    }
135	
136	    state.linkLevel++
137	    state.md.inline.tokenize(state)
138	    state.linkLevel--
139	
140	    state.push('link_close', 'a', -1)
141	  }
142	
143	  state.pos = pos
144	  state.posMax = max
145	  return true
146	}

content.text: The bug is in `src/rules_inline/backticks.ts`. When a backtick run finds no closer, the rule sets a single global flag, `backticksScanned`, meaning "no closer exists anywhere". But the scan only covered text after that run. The bug report's input shows the failure. Link label scanning hits the backtick at offset 14 (`baz\``), finds no closer after it, and sets the flag. The main pass then reaches the valid span at offset 5 (`` `bar` ``), sees the flag, and emits it as literal text. The fix is to record where the failed scan started and only trust the shortcut for openers at or after that position.

content.text:
The bug is fixed. A later valid code span is no longer shown as literal text after an unclosed `[` or `![` label.

**Cause:** In `src/rules_inline/backticks.ts`, a backtick run with no matching closer set a single global flag, `backticksScanned`, meaning "no closer exists". That flag was set by a scan that only covered text after the failing run. Link-label scanning hit the stray backtick in `` [foo `bar` baz` ``, set the flag, and the main pass then treated the valid `` `bar` `` opener as unmatched.

**Fix:**
- `src/rules_inline/state_inline.ts`: replaced the boolean with `backticksScannedFrom`, the position where the failed scan started (default `Infinity`).
- `src/rules_inline/backticks.ts`: the shortcut now applies only when the opener is at or after that position and no closer of the same length follows it. A first attempt that dropped the per-length check broke the spec example `` `foo``bar`` ``, so I restored it.

**Tests:**
- Added `test/markdown-it/backticks.test.mjs` with five cases: the link and image examples from the report, the minimal `` [`a`b` ``, the default preset, and an unmatched-backtick case that must stay literal.
- The new file passes 5/5. The full markdown-it suite passes 300/300, the CommonMark suite passes 652/652, and `tsc --noEmit` exits 0.
- I did not run the full `npm test` script (it also runs lint and build), and I did not run ESLint.
